_doc: 邓兴华 L05 配套练习内容（中等）· 2026-08-02 重设计。主题：运动·喜好表达；语法：G13 祈使句 / G14 What 问句 / G15 like 搭配。全部语篇按段落（分段）+ 首行缩进组织。格式要求：阅读/完形/选词语篇分段；选项竖向对齐；五选四/选词答案直接填入文中空；简答 Q39 一般疑问句+Why/Why not、Q40 翻译为中文；语法复盘 5 选择 + 5 填空。

paragraphs: My name is Li Ming. I am twelve. I am a student at Sunshine Middle School. I like sports very much. What sports do you like? I like basketball and ping-pong. They are fun and good for us.

After class, I play basketball with my friends at the playground. It is fun and relaxing. We play together every afternoon. My friends like to watch TV, too. They watch sports games on TV. What games do they like? They like soccer games. Soccer is interesting for them.
I like to play ping-pong, too. It is easy for me. I have a bat and a ball. Please play sports with us. Don't stay at home all day. Sports are good for us. Come and play with us this weekend!

questions.q: What do my friends like to do?

paragraphs: Hi, everyone! Our school has a Sports Day this Saturday. You can play basketball, soccer and volleyball. Please come to the playground at 8:00 a.m. The games start at nine and end at twelve. Bring your bat or your ball. Your parents can come, too.

Please wear sports clothes. Bring some water and a towel. Don't eat too much before you play. Listen to the teacher and follow the rules. The rules are easy. Don't run in the classroom. Don't play in the street. Follow your teacher at the games.

After the games, we have a small party. Don't forget to bring your friends! What sports do you like to play? Tell your teacher. Sports are fun and good for your body. You can win a ball or a bat. It is interesting! We have games for boys and girls. Come and have fun with us. Please come with your friends.

questions.q: “Don't eat too much before you play.” 的意思是？
What is the passage mainly about?

paragraphs: Sports are good for your body and your mind. Do you like sports? What sports do you like? Many students like to play basketball and soccer. Some like tennis and ping-pong. Sports are interesting and fun. Do you want to be strong? Then do sports every day.

Playing sports every day helps you grow strong. It is also relaxing. When you play with friends, you have fun. Sports make you happy and healthy. Playing volleyball is good for your arms. Playing soccer is good for your legs. Running and jumping are easy for students, too.

Please do sports after class. Don't watch TV for a long time. Don't play computer games too much. Get up and play! You can play in the playground with your friends. Sports are easy and fun to learn. They are good friends of students. Play sports and you can have a good day.

opts: good for your body and mind

questions.q: What do many students like to play?

w5.title: 根据短文内容，从方框中选出最佳句子填入文中空白处，使短文通顺连贯（答案字母直接填在空内）
paragraphs: Playing sports is fun and healthy. Sports are good for your body and your mind. They make you strong and happy. ___1___ Get up and do some exercise every morning. You can run in the park or play in the playground with your friends.
___2___ Play basketball or soccer with your friends after class. It is fun and relaxing for you. Exercise helps you study well, too. When you play, you have fun with your friends.
___3___ Eat well and drink water. Vegetables and fruit are good for you. Milk is good for your body, too. Drink water after sports, too.

___4___ Watch sports games on TV and learn from good players. Learn from the good players and play very well. Follow these tips and have fun! Sports are good friends of students. Do sports every day and you can be healthy.
candidates: Please play sports with your family.
Don't stay at home all day.
Don't play computer games all day.
Don't eat too much fast food.
Watch TV for a long time.

sa.title: 阅读短文，回答下列问题或按要求完成句子
paragraphs: I am Mike. I am thirteen years old. I am a student at a middle school. I like sports very much. What sports do I like? I like basketball and volleyball. After class, I play basketball with my friends at the playground. It is fun and relaxing. Sports make me strong, happy and healthy.

My friend Tom likes to watch TV. He watches sports games on TV for a long time. He says sports on TV are interesting. But I like to play, not to watch. I like to play every day. Please do sports every day. Don't sit at home all day! Come and play with us every day. You can play basketball, volleyball or tennis with us. It is good for your body and your mind.

questions.q: What does Tom like to do?
questions.answer: He likes to watch TV (sports games on TV).

questions.q: “Don't sit at home all day!” 的中文意思是什么？
Do you want to play sports every day like Mike? Why or why not?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. Because playing sports is fun and good for us.

questions.q: 将句子 “Please do sports every day.” 译成中文。

writing.title: 书面表达（15 分）
writing.prompt: 你叫 Nick，请用英语写一篇短文，介绍你喜欢的运动、你喜欢的运动，以及你给同学的建议。
writing.requirements: 1. 使用本课词汇与句型（祈使句、What 问句、like + 名词 / like to do）；2. 60–80 词；3. 条理清楚，语句通顺。
writing.sample: My name is Nick. I like sports. What sports do I like? I like basketball and ping-pong. After class, I play basketball with my friends. It is fun and relaxing. I like to watch sports games on TV, too. They are interesting. But I don't like computer games. They are boring. Please do sports every day. Don't stay at home all day. Sports are good for us.
